resources.string: To work properly, this app needs access to your camera, location, and notifications. One or more of these permissions are currently disabled. Please enable them in settings to continue.
To work properly, this app needs GPS location services enabled. Please enable GPS in settings to continue.
To keep timestamps accurate, this app requires automatic date and time (internet time). Please enable it in your device settings to continue.
Required to capture detailed images of mosquito specimens for accurate identification and analysis.
Needed to log exact collection sites and associate each specimen with its geographic origin for field tracking.
Allows the app to show upload progress, completion alerts, and other key background status updates.
